Shape::SubSequence &amp;subSeq, bool lastVis, int32_t *lastKF, float pos, Shape::Keyframe &amp;outA)\n   {\n      int32_t prevIDX=subSeq.firstKeyFrame-1;\n      uint32_t lastFrame=0;\n      uint32_t \n   void getSubsequenceKeyframes(const Shape::Sequence &amp;seq, const Shape::SubSequence &amp;subSeq, uint32_t nodeIdx, float pos, Shape::Keyframe &amp;outA, Shape::Keyframe &amp;outB, float &amp;outInterpolation)\n   {\n      int32_t prevIDX=subSeq.firstKeyFrame-1;\n      int32_t nextIDX=subSeq.firstKeyFrame+subSeq.numKeyFrames;\n      for (uint32_t i=0; i&lt;subSeq.numKeyFrames; i++)\n      {\n         const Shape::Keyframe &amp;kf = mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[subSeq.firstKeyFrame+i];\n         if (kf.pos &lt;= pos + 0.001f)\n         {\n            prevIDX = subSeq.firstKeyFrame+i;\n         }\n         else if (kf.pos &gt;= pos - 0.001f)\n         {\n            nextIDX = subSeq.firstKeyFrame+i;\n            break;\n         }\n      }\n      \n      // Refine and determine interpolation value\n      if (seq.cyclic)\n      {\n         float diff = 0.0f;\n         if (prevIDX &lt; subSeq.firstKeyFrame)\n         {\n            prevIDX = subSeq.firstKeyFrame + subSeq.numKeyFrames-1;\n            diff = mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[nextIDX].pos - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos;\n            outInterpolation = (pos - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos) / diff;\n         }\n         else if (nextIDX &gt;= subSeq.firstKeyFrame+subSeq.numKeyFrames)\n         {\n            nextIDX = subSeq.firstKeyFrame;\n            diff = (mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[nextIDX].pos + 1.0f) - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos;\n            outInterpolation = (pos - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos) / diff;\n         }\n         \n         if (prevIDX == nextIDX)\n         {\n (std::fpclassify(diff) == FP_ZERO)\n            {\n               outInterpolation = std::fpclassify(pos - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos) == FP_ZERO ? 0.0f : 1.0f;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n               outInterpolation = (pos - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos) / diff;\n            }\n         }\n      }\n      else\n      {\n         if (prevIDX &lt; subSeq.firstKeyFrame)\n         {\n            prevIDX = subSeq.firstKeyFrame;\n            outInterpolation = 0.0f;\n         }\n         else if (nextIDX &gt;= subSeq.firstKeyFrame+subSeq.numKeyFrames)\n         {\n            nextIDX = subSeq.firstKeyFrame+subSeq.numKeyFrames-1;\n            outInterpolation = 1.0f;\n         }\n         else if (prevIDX == nextIDX)\n         {\n            outInterpolation = 0.0f;\n         }\n         else\n         {\n            float diff = mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[nextIDX].pos - mShape-&gt;mKeyframes[prevIDX].pos;\n {\n      slm::quat qa = xfmA.rot.toQuat();\n      slm::quat qb = xfmB.rot.toQuat();\n      \n      slm::quat qc = CompatInterpolate(qa, qb, pos);\n      float invPos = 1.0 - pos;\n      slm::vec3 pc = Write the header file with the escaped string\n    file(WRITE \"${OUTPUT_HEADER}\" \"// Auto-generated header file\\n\")\n    file(APPEND \"${OUTPUT_HEADER}\" \"const char* ${CONST_NAME} = \\\"${ESCAPED_FILE_CONTENT}\\\";\\n\")\n\n    message(STATUS \"Generated header file '${OUTPUT_HEADER}' from '${INPUT_FILE}'\")\nendfunction()\n\n\ngenerate_escaped_string_header(\"TribesViewer/lineShader.wgsl\" \"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lineShader.wgsl.h\" \"sLineShaderCode\")\ngenerate_escaped_string_header(\"TribesViewer/modelShader.wgsl\" \"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/modelShader.wgsl.h\" \"sModelShaderCode\")\ngenerate_escaped_string_header(\"TribesViewer/terrainShader.wgsl\" \"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/terrainShader.wgsl.h\" \"sTerrainShaderCode\")\n\n\n# Set C++ standard\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Specify the include directories\ninclude_directories(include imgui include/slm \"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}\")\n\n# Define a variable to optionally hold the SDL3 static library path\nset(SDL3_LIB_DIR \"\" CACHE FILEPATH \"Path to SDL3 static library (.a)\")\n\n# Try to use pkg-config to find SDL3 (only if static lib not provided)\nif (SDL3_LIB_DIR STREQUAL \"\")\n    find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)\n    pkg_check_modules(SDL3 REQUIRED sdl3)\n\n    if (SDL3_FOUND)\n        message(STATUS \"Using SDL3 from pkg-config\")\n        include_directories(${SDL3_INCLUDE_DIRS})\n        link_directories(${SDL3_LIBRARY_DIRS})\n        set(SDL3_LIBS ${SDL3_LIBRARIES})\n    else()\n        message(FATAL_ERROR \"SDL3 not found via pkg-config and no static library provided\")\n    endif()\nelse()\n    message(STATUS \"Using static SDL3 library\")\n    \n    # Allow the user to provide include directory if using the static lib\n    set(SDL3_INCLUDE_DIR \"\" CACHE PATH \"Path to SDL3 include directory\")\n\n    if (SDL3_INCLUDE_DIR STREQUAL \"\")\n        message(FATAL_ERROR \"SDL3_INCLUDE_DIR must be set when using SDL3 static library\")\n    endif()\n\n    # Add SDL3 include directory and link the static SDL3 lib\n    include_directories(${SDL3_INCLUDE_DIR})\n    link_directories(${SDL3_LIB_DIR})\n    set(SDL3_LIBS SDL3)\nendif()\n\nset(TARGET_DEFINES NO_BOOST)\n\nif (USE_WGPU_NATIVE)\nset(TARGET_DEFINES ${TARGET_DEFINES} WGPU_NATIVE IMGUI_IMPL_WEBGPU_BACKEND_WGPU)\nset(TARGET_HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS\n\t${TARGET_HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS}\n\t${WGPU_NATIVE_PATH}/ffi/webgpu-headers\n\t)\nset(LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS ${LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS} ${WGPU_NATIVE_PATH}/target/debug)\n\nfind_library(WEBGPU_NATIVE_LIB_PATH\n    NAMES libwgpu_native.a libwgpu_native.lib\n    PATHS ${LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS}\n    NAMES_PER_DIR\n)\n\nset(TARGET_LIBS ${TARGET_LIBS} ${WEBGPU_NATIVE_LIB_PATH})\nelse()\nset(TARGET_DEFINES ${TARGET_DEFINES} WGPU_NATIVE IMGUI_IMPL_WEBGPU_BACKEND_DAWN)\nset(TARGET_LIBS ${TARGET_LIBS} webgpu)\nendif()\n\ninclude_directories(${TARGET_HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS})\n\nset(PLATFORM_GLOBS \"\")\n\nif(APPLE)\nset(PLATFORM_GLOBS \"Tribesviewer/SDLApple.mm\")\nendif()\n\n# Collect source files\nfile(GLOB TRIBESVIEWER_SRC\n    \"TribesViewer/*.cpp\"\n    \"slm/*.cpp\"\n    \"imgui/*.cpp\"\n    ${PLATFORM_GLOBS}\n)\n\n# Add executable\nadd_executable(TribesViewer ${TRIBESVIEWER_SRC})\n\n# Link SDL3 and platform extras\nif (MSVC)\n    set(PLATFORM_EXTRA_LIBS ws2_32 userenv ntdll opengl32 propsys runtimeobject)\nelse()\n    set(PLATFORM_EXTRA_LIBS -lm -pthread)\nendif()\ntarget_link_libraries(TribesViewer ${SDL3_LIBS} ${TARGET_LIBS} ${PLATFORM_EXTRA_LIBS})\ntarget_compile_definitions(TribesViewer PRIVATE ${TARGET_DEFINES})\n\n# Link frameworks\nif(APPLE)\n    find_library(COREFOUNDATION_LIBRARY CoreFoundation)\n    find_library(METAL_LIBRARY Metal)\n    find_library(QUARTZCORE_LIBRARY QuartzCore)\n\n    target_link_libraries(TribesViewer\n        ${COREFOUNDATION_LIBRARY}\n        ${METAL_LIBRARY}\n        ${QUARTZCORE_LIBRARY}\n    )\nendif()\n\n"
